title: Mileage PDF, branded documents and full calendar
details: Mileage exports are now a single PDF showing each visit route, addresses, leg mileage, totals and stored receipts
Assessor details now include college name, college logo and place of work, with branding added to Milos PDFs
The home calendar now says Open Calendar and opens a full monthly view; tapping a day uses the existing editable booking view
Planning and Private by design are removed from the More menu
Route learner checkboxes now remain selected so efficient routes can be planned normally
